# Aaron Hall, Attorney

> > Aaron Hall is a Minneapolis-based business law attorney specializing in corporate formation, contracts, employment law, intellectual property, and commercial litigation for business owners and startups.

Aaron Hall's practice focuses on providing comprehensive legal counsel to business owners in Minnesota, with expertise spanning business formation, employment matters, intellectual property protection, and dispute resolution. The firm serves clients ranging from startups to established companies across the Minneapolis-St. Paul region.
